[center]1. [b]REQUIRED:[/b] Make sure you've downloaded and set up [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/center]
[center]2. [b]REQUIRED:[/b] Download and make sure [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative textures[/url] is working for you.[/center]
[center]3. Download this mod's most recent file, and extract the zipped file into Stardew Valley ➛ Mods. If you're having trouble finding those folders, see [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started]this guide.[/url][/center]

[center]After installing, head to robins to buy a paint bucket and you're ready to turn your Christmas tree into a pretty heel chair![/center]
